name: resqnet
description: ResQNet - Real-Time Emergency Response & Resource Dispatch Network

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true})"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client dev"
